name: @the-inclusionist/game-soccer
description: Association football on the accessibility-first Inclusionist engine. Reimplemented from a feature description, not forked from any unlicensed source.
comment:name: Package `@the-inclusionist/game-soccer` in repository `the-inclusionist/game-soccer` (ADR-0082).
They MIRROR each other, so there is nothing to hold in the head. `game-<slug>` and not
`the-inclusionist-game-<slug>`, because ADR-0071 §1 says the organisation already names the
container and repeating it would say the word twice.
comment:private: `private: true` UNTIL there is something to publish. ADR-0068 §3 says a game publishes itself as a
package so the catalogue's manifest can select it, and that day this line comes off. A scaffold that
could be published by accident is worse than one that cannot be published at all.

scripts.validate: npm run typecheck && vitest run && vite build

`file:../SP-the-inclusionist-tracer`, which is `npm link` with another spelling: a symlink walks
straight past the `files` field, so a packaging defect stays invisible until somebody else installs.
The engine was published on 2026-09-06 and this repository stopped being a special case the same day.
